B0DFVY6HS9.title: SONOFF SNZB-05P Zigbee Water Leak Sensor for Alarm System and Smart Home Automation, Wireless Mini Flood Detector for Kitchen Bathroom Basement 1Pack
bullets: Long-lasting Battery Life, Worry-free Monitoring: The SONOFF SNZB-05P water leak sensor is equipped with a high-capacity battery of CR2477 that supports up to 5 years of continuous monitoring, reducing maintenance hassles and ensuring your home's safety.

Multi-functional Detection, Comprehensive Coverage: With various detection methods, whether it's general water leakage or drip detection, or pairing with extension cable for large-scale or narrow area detection, it meets the needs of various scenarios and provides all-around protection for your home safety. Suitable for various scenarios such as basements, kitchens, and laundry room, the SONOFF SNZB-05P water leak detector is an indispensable part of your smart home system.

Smart Linkage, Timely Alarms: When a water leak is detected, the SONOFF SNZB-05P water leak alarm can trigger a gateway sound alarm and send an app message alert through scene linkage, ensuring you are the first to know.The local scene linkage gateway sound alarm function is WiFi independent, providing reliable safety alerts even when the network is unstable.

Multiple Alarms, No Missed Alerts: In case of continuous water detection, the SONOFF SNZB-05P water sensor alarm reports every 10 minutes, and the redundant alarm setting ensures no alerts are missed, even during network fluctuations.

Smart Home, Safety Upgrade: The SONOFF SNZB-05P smart leak detector as a zigbee sensor, which needs to be used with Zigbee Hub. As part of the smart home ecosystem, the SONOFF SNZB-05P water leakage detector can be linked with other smart home devices via Zigbee 3.0 protocol, enhancing the overall home security.

B07D39MSZS.title: Aqara Water Leak Sensor 1 Pack, Zigbee Water Leak Detector for Alarm System
bullets: [Notes] An Aqara Hub is required and sold separately. Not compatible with hubs from other brands. Requires a secure 2.4GHz Wi-Fi connection for Hub M2, M1S, E1, M1S Gen2, G2H Pro, and G2H; or 2.4/5GHz Wi-Fi for Camera Hub G3. (Hub M2 also supports wired Ethernet via RJ45.). Pair the Zigbee Water Leak Sensor with an Aqara Hub before connecting to Apple HomeKit, Google Home, or Alexa. For a stable Zigbee connection, ensure the sensor is placed within 10 meters(33 ft) of the Aqara Hub.

[Proximity] To ensure a stable connection, keep the Aqara Water Leak Sensor within 400 inches (approximately 10 meters) of the Aqara Zigbee Hub, and place the hub within the same range of your Wi-Fi router. Ensure both are connected to the same local area network (LAN). Zigbee2MQTT and comparable third-party USB dongles are not officially supported by Aqara. Full product functionality may be limited or unavailable.

[Drip and Leak Detection] Equipped with highly sensitive probes that detect water levels as low as 0.5 mm (approximately 0.02 inch), this water leak detector instantly sends alerts to your phone and triggers the local alarm on the Aqara Hub whenever a leak is detected.

[Home automation] The water leak detectors for home can control and trigger other Aqara devices when water is detected, allowing you to take prompt action to keep your home safe. ***Requires Aqara Hub, not third-party hub.

[Wireless & Compact Design] No wiring or screws are required. The small, sleek design allows you to place the Zigbee leak sensor on any flat surface in your kitchen, basement, laundry room, or any area you want to monitor. Recommended placements include near or under toilets, water heaters, washing machines, dishwashers, sinks, fish tanks, sump pumps, or any area prone to leaks.

[Industry-Leading Quality] Durable IP67 water-proof housing with rust-proof exterior coating. Please remove the battery tab before use. If the device does not work, check the battery level. For any questions, please feel free to contact us.

B095TR9NYR.title: Aeotec SmartThings SmartThings Water Leak Sensor, ZigBee, Battery Powered, Smart Home Hub Compatible
bullets: LEAK AND FLOOD PROTECTION:Place the Aeotec SmartThings Water Leak Sensor under sinks, refrigerators, washing machines, and more to detect excess water or moisture and receive immediate alerts on your phone by connecting to the Aeotec Smart Home Hub and using the SmartThings app

SHUT DOWN SYSTEMS: You can program your other connected smart devices to shut off water flow or shut down electronics automatically to prevent electrocution and damage to your home from water leaks and irregular temperatures

B072DYHPY7.title: Centralite by Ezlo Water Sensor | Monitors Your Whole Home for Leaks | Detects Water Leaks in a Kitchen, Bathroom, Basement or Laundry Room | Zigbee Smart Water Sensor
bullets: PREVENT COSTLY FLOOD DAMAGE — Protect your home from expensive leaks and floods by installing a Centralite water sensor near water heaters, drain pans, and underneath sinks. The Water Sensor and Water Leak Detector are small, easy to use, and fit almost anywhere. The Centralite water sensor is directly on the ground, and it will notify you when it detects the presence of water.

HOW DOES IT WORK? — The Centralite water sensor can be placed on any non-conductive surface, like granite, glass, brick, or tile. Ideally, look for areas near or under a home's most common source of water leaks, such as a refrigerator, washing machine, water heater, or toilet. The conductors on the underside of the sensor will alert you at the first indication of excessive moisture or liquid that they encounter so you can address the issue swiftly and avoid costly and devastating water damage.

EASY TO USE — The Centralite water sensor has “pull-to-pair” joining. The device ships with the battery pre-installed, and all that is needed to begin the joining process is to pull out a small plastic tab from the bottom of the device.
COMPATIBLE — The Centralite water sensor is entirely ZigBee HA 1.2 certified and is guaranteed to function with all open ZigBee HA 1.2-certified hubs and devices.

SATISFACTION GUARANTEED — With the purchase of any Centralite by Ezlo product, we offer the Ezlo Smart Home for Life Guarantee, including, anywhere access for your system, guaranteed compatibility, the industry’s longest warranty, always up-to-date cloud infrastructure and Real people here to help.

B0GWQKHST5.title: Zigbee Water Detector with 110 dB Siren Alarm, Wireless Water Sensor
bullets: Instant Leak Detection: A highly sensitive water sensor monitors for leaks in real time and triggers immediate alerts to prevent water damage in the kitchen, bathroom, and other areas.
Loud 110 dB Siren Alarm: The built-in, powerful alarm provides an audible on-site warning, effectively alerting you to a water leak—even when you are away from your smartphone.
Smart App Control & Event Log: Enables remote monitoring, alarm muting, and access to a 24/7 event log; compatible with Home Assistant and Zigbee2mqtt.
Ultra-Low Power Consumption: Standby current ≤10 μA with a standby time of up to 12 months; powered by 2 × LR03 (AAA) batteries for long-term use (batteries not included).
Smart Scene Integration: Works with a Zigbee gateway to set up automations—such as turning on lights, automatically closing water valves, or sending push notifications when a leak is detected.
